bandReport.notes: 26 questions, contiguous 35-60, no gaps and no duplicates. Per-page split: p06 Q35-Q40 (printed 13-A), p07 Q41-Q48 (15-A), p08 Q49-Q53 (17-A), p09 Q54-Q60 (19-A). BAND EDGES BOTH CLEAN: p06 opens at Q35 with a complete stem and full option block, which joins B1's close at Q34 (B1 was verified to end complete); p09 ends at Q60, whose option (d) 'Mobilisation of public opinion' was crop-verified at 8x with the two-column rule stopping below it, blank paper beneath, then the footer '( 19 - A )'. Nothing continues overleaf, and this joins B3's opening at Q61 — so 35-60 and 61-88 abut with no gap. CODE-OPTION ORDER IS THE HEADLINE OF THIS BAND. Q53 puts the ALL-THREE row '1, 2 and 3' at (a), NOT at (d) — crop-verified at 12x, reading (a) 1, 2 and 3 / (b) 1 and 2 only / (c) 2 and 3 only / (d) 1 and 3 only. That inverts every other code block in this paper. For contrast, also crop-verified in this band: Q39 runs 1 only / 2 only / 1 and 2 only / 2 and 3 only (no all-three row); Q46 is the classic two-statement code 1 only / 2 only / Both 1 and 2 / Neither 1 nor 2; Q50 is the band's only FOUR-statement code, running 1 and 2 only / 2 and 3 only / 1 and 3 only / 1, 2, 3 and 4. Taken with B1's Q7, Q8 and Q25, this booklet uses at least six different code layouts and no option letter may be inferred from where a row of that shape usually sits. TWO PRINTED DEFECTS, both transcribed faithfully and flagged on their rows: Q35's stem reads 'furthering the goals of social EXCLUSION' (verified at 12x) where Granville Austin's known phrase is 'social REVOLUTION'; and Q43's option (a) reads 'Alexander Cunnigham' (verified at 16x), dropping an 'n' from Cunningham. Q37 is structurally odd — it prints the standard 'Select the correct answer using the code given below :' line but its four options are State names, not code rows. No Match Lists, no figures, graphs, diagrams or circuits anywhere in this band. No 'P.T.O.' marking on any page. Devanagari show-through from the Hindi on the reverse of each leaf is present but faint and obscured no English glyph; ignored as show-through, not content.

questions.stem: Who among the following considered the Directive Principles of State Policy as aiming at 'furthering the goals of social exclusion' ?

flags: PRINTED-AS-IS: the stem reads 'furthering the goals of social EXCLUSION', crop-verified at 12x (e-x-c-l-u-s-i-o-n, unambiguous). Granville Austin's well-known characterisation of the DPSP is 'furthering the goals of the social REVOLUTION', so this is very likely a printing error in the booklet; it is transcribed faithfully and not corrected. Worth noting because the misprint inverts the sense of the phrase the question turns on.
